blind_spots.blind_spot: No export-control or CUI posture for the design data the tool ingests
blind_spots.operator_reality: A Lockheed or Northrop board stackup, pin assignment and fab rule set is ITAR-controlled technical data. The moment a tool touches it, the prime's export-control officer and security team ask where the part-optimization database lives, what the AI sends off the machine, and whether JITX holds NIST 800-171/CMMC at the company level. That review, not the engineering value, is what sets the calendar — and it is the same clock that eats the funded months on a program.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The team's center of gravity is compilers, geometry and optimization research; their own bios are Berkeley/MIT algorithm pedigree with no acquisition or security-review experience.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Part optimization database ... Air gapped installation

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Your approved AI' assumes a capable model exists inside the customer's enclave
blind_spots.operator_reality: In an air-gapped or classified design environment the approved model is not a frontier model — it is whatever an ATO'd, on-prem deployment allows, often a quantized open-weights model years behind. If the optimization loop's edit quality was demonstrated with a connected frontier model, the same loop inside the enclave produces worse candidate designs and more HFSS iterations, which is precisely the schedule argument they are selling against.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Demos run on customer compute during evaluation, where the buyer's connected corporate model is available; the degraded classified case only shows up after the deal, during rollout.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: JITX runs on your infrastructure with your approved AI.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No design-assurance provenance story for generated hardware
blind_spots.operator_reality: Boards that fly on aerospace or defense platforms carry qualification and design-assurance obligations — reviewed schematics, traceable rule application, signature authority on what changed and why. 'AI proposes edits' has to survive a design review board that wants to know which human accepted each geometry decision and how it maps to the requirement. Without a generated-artifact audit trail tied to requirements, the tool stalls at the CAD organization rather than at the engineer who loved it.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The go-to-market is bottom-up ('Start for free', per-engineer trials) while adoption at a prime is a tools-qualification decision above the engineer's level — the classic missing advocacy chain.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Express requirements, constraints, stackups, and engineering rules in Python. AI proposes edits. Engineers can read, review, and run the code.

opener_hook: Your plans page puts 'air gapped installation' and a shared 'part optimization database' on the same tier, which is the first thing a prime's export-control officer will pull on — and Lockheed is already listed on your homepage.
what_they_do: Code-based PCB design automation: requirements become Python, an AI edits the code, and JITX generates and simulation-checks the board.
